how to reprint laboratory bill?

Click the ‘Reprint’ button to generate the reprint of the bill. On clicking the ‘Reprint’ button, the previously billed details will be loaded into the pop-up screen. From there, users can choose to print the service bill, deduct bill, and also take a thermal print by clicking the print button. You can also use F12 / Alt+ R to reprint the bill.

how to load a patient appointment details in billing screen

For viewing all the appointments for today, click on the button near ‘Appointment no’. Double click on the appointment number, then the patient, doctor and token booked details will automatically be loaded.

what are the input fields for the service billing advanced
